abstract: A xenogeneic antiserum (PG-1) raised against the germ cells of the 13.5d p.c. mouse conceptus reacts with the fetal germ cells of both sexes and adult male germ cells, but not with any nongerminal tissue that has been tested. PG-1 can also react with the EC cells of four different teratocarcinoma cell lines. There are, however, marked differences in the absorptive capacity of the different EC cell lines. The antigen(s) recognized by the antiserum are confined to only a proportion of cells in some EC lines. This antiserum has a number of potential applications in studies of the origin and development of the mouse germ cell lineage.
abstract_ja: マウス13.5日胚の胚細胞に対して作製された異種抗血清(PG-1)は、両性の胎児の胚細胞と成体の雄の胚細胞に反応するが、検査した胚細胞以外の組織には反応しない。また、PG-1は4つの奇形癌細胞株の胎児性癌細胞と反応する。ただし、胎児性癌細胞株間で吸収能力には大きな差があり、一部の株では抗原を認識する細胞は一部に限られる。この抗血清は、マウス胚細胞系譜の起源と発生の研究に多くの応用が期待できる。
